canonical_registration: No canonical EXP/H/IDEA id is minted here. Before dispatch, register an additive contract with tools/allocate_id.py and Coordinator records; bind immutable sources, inputs, environment, commands, write scopes, and review tasks.

prerequisite.required_disposition: Repair the failing committed-run-supersession tests without weakening them; commit experiment and independent-review disposition before dispatch.

question: Does an orbit-canonical pair table retain a cold end-to-end cost advantage when driven by the existing decomposition caller over a fixed public-synthetic target stream, after charging all setup, query, exact-witness, and process costs?

evidence_boundary.claim_scope: Finite caller-level point decomposition only; no relation-rank, discrete-log, full index-calculus, rho, security, or asymptotic claim.

workloads.stream_rule: M=1,32,512 use prefixes of the same frozen 512-target stream; all arms receive identical targets and fresh processes.
workloads.target_rule: Public subgroup targets selected before timing without conditioning on decomposition success; scalar/label sidecar withheld from timed workers.

arms.canonical_reused: Build the exact orbit-canonical table once per fresh job, retain original pair witnesses and inverse transport, then answer M sequential caller requests.
arms.expanded_reused: Build the exact full-point pair table once per fresh job, then answer the identical M sequential caller requests. Primary comparator.
arms.expanded_rebuilt: Build a fresh full-point pair table per request. Control for the value of table reuse itself.

controls: Identical frozen base, target stream, caller API, binary, host, process boundary, and field/group arithmetic across arms.
Independent N19 replay of the accepted exact-three panel and all 6,909 frozen target-orbit cases before timing.
Every returned witness replays by exact group addition to its original target and every summand is in the admitted base.
Every target is independently checked on-curve and in the admitted subgroup; zero-yield and miss cases remain in the sample.
Fresh process per job; no hidden target joins, previous table, point-to-log table, full-group catalog, or witness cache.
Randomized paired arm order; four timing repetitions are summarized within each stream and are not treated as independent samples.

analysis.aggregation: Within each target stream, aggregate four technical repetitions; compare arms on paired streams.
analysis.interval: Two-sided 95% paired bootstrap over eight independent target streams, 10,000 resamples, fixed committed seed.
analysis.promotion_gate: Complete valid primary data; median canonical/reused-expanded cold end-to-end ratio <= 0.80 and 95% interval upper endpoint < 1.0. Report N19 separately; no pooling across base sizes.
analysis.zero_yield: Cost-per-witness is null; report observed cost, zero yield and outcome explicitly.
analysis.censoring: A timeout or incomplete pair is right-censored, never UNSAT and never dropped from the report.

dispatch_gate: PR #1382 validation failures repaired without weakening supersession checks; experiment and independent-review disposition committed.
Coordinator allocates canonical IDs and freezes source/input hashes, adapter commands, environment, ownership, write scopes and artifact paths.
Independent point/group checker and caller adapter pass all correctness controls before timing.
local_design_validation_is_not: mathematical proof of a performance gain
